project.name: Continuity Test Project
project.description: Synthetic project for testing file-backed session continuity.

purpose.summary: Verify that a fresh coding session can continue a bounded task from persisted files.
goals: reconstruct project context from canonical files
verify dependencies and record one bounded result

constraints: Canonical Markdown and JSON files are authoritative.
Do not mark work done without evidence and review.
Do not commit or push test data.

providers.notes: Selected only for the isolated continuity test.

unknowns: Production technology stack is intentionally unspecified.

context.scope: A single file-backed continuity proof task.
context.conventions: Verify files and dependencies; preserve unknowns; no secrets.
